jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
PROJECT MANAGER

Remote (U.S)

Company Overview

For more than two decades, our client has built mission-critical software for emergency medical services, fire departments, and public safety agencies across the United States, helping responders document patient care in the field, meet state and national reporting requirements, and move critical data between dispatch systems, medical devices, hospitals, and billing platforms. The company serves agencies ranging from small rural departments to some of the largest metropolitan fire and EMS systems in the country, and it has earned a reputation for configurable software, deep domain knowledge, and responsive, knowledgeable customer support. Backed by a large, long-term software investor, the organization pairs the stability of an established business with the autonomy of a lean, remote-friendly team grounded in accountability, adaptability, and humility, and leadership has made AI adoption a company-wide priority. Now in an active growth phase, the company is investing in its commercial organization, expanding its product capabilities, and strengthening the delivery engine that brings new and existing customers onto its platform, and this role sits at the center of that effort.

Position Overview

New business is accelerating and existing agencies are expanding their use of the platform, so our client is establishing a dedicated, full-time Project Manager within its Professional Services organization. Reporting to the Director of Professional Services and Support, this hire will own a high-velocity portfolio of customer implementations, integrations, and data exports, typically 20 or more concurrent projects at a time. This is a rare opportunity for a project manager with roots in EMS, fire, or public safety software to become the central delivery owner at a respected, mission-driven company. First, the role carries true end-to-end ownership and direct visibility, since the Project Manager serves as each customer’s primary point of contact from kickoff through go-live and revenue is recognized only when a project closes. Second, it keeps the hire close to the field, leading training for the administrators and frontline responders who rely on the software every day while working hands-on with the technical setup behind each deployment. Third, it offers a clear path toward senior-level scope in process improvement, product partnership, and the design of new implementation offerings, supported by a well-documented delivery playbook of project templates, work instructions, and training videos that allows a strong hire to ramp quickly. The position is remote within the U.S. with 10% to 20% travel and occasional early morning or evening go-lives across U.S. time zones.

Position Responsibilities

Own a portfolio of 20 or more concurrent implementation, integration, and data export projects from kickoff through go-live, driving each one to customer sign-off on time and within budget so that completed work converts to recognized revenue.
Build project plans from established templates in the team’s project management platform, and improve existing templates or create new ones as the company introduces new implementation and integration offerings.
Track actual hours and tasks against estimates, report variance, and manage scope and risk proactively, escalating to leadership with a clear recommendation before issues turn into delays.
Serve as the primary point of contact for each customer, leading kickoffs, status meetings, and go-lives with agency administrators, clinicians, and leadership, and keeping customers and internal stakeholders aligned through consistent, transparent status reporting.
Design and deliver administrator and end-user training, primarily remote with occasional on-site sessions, so that agency users reach go-live confident and capable on the platform.
Reset customer expectations directly and with tact when scope or timelines shift, protecting long-term relationships while keeping projects moving toward completion.
Configure the product, set up data imports, and execute standard exports such as billing and state reporting files, troubleshooting configuration and data issues hands-on before escalating and building the functional and technical expertise to take on more of this work independently over time.
Coordinate complex integrations, including CAD and third-party vendor connections, by gathering requirements from customers and vendors and giving internal developers what they need to deliver, while explaining technical decisions in plain language to non-technical stakeholders.
Identify customer needs for add-on modules, additional agencies, integrations, and training during implementations and post-go-live check-ins and hand qualified leads to Sales, while supporting presales efforts with scoping, hour estimates, statements of work, and product demonstrations.
Apply AI tools to streamline delivery, documentation, and training content, share lessons learned with Professional Services and Product leadership, and partner with the support team on post-go-live handoffs, tier-2 support within areas of expertise, and occasional backup coverage.

Required

Position Qualifications

A proven track record of delivering customer software implementations on time and within budget, with the ability to cite personal on-time and on-budget performance.
3+ years of project management or software implementation experience, including independent ownership of multiple concurrent customer projects from kickoff through go-live.
Experience with an EMS, fire, public safety, or GovTech software provider, or in closely related healthcare data work such as EMS billing, health data exchange, or emergency department and prehospital EHR implementations.
Hands-on experience building project plans and tracking hours against estimates in a dedicated project management platform, along with working knowledge of CRM tools.
A track record of delivering software training to administrator and end-user audiences, both remotely and in person.
Working knowledge of SaaS applications, system integrations, and data exchange methods such as APIs, web services, and SFTP, with hands-on experience configuring products, setting up data imports, and personally resolving data or integration issues.

Preferred

A field or clinical background as an EMT, paramedic, firefighter, or clinician is strongly preferred, along with familiarity with NEMSIS and state EMS reporting requirements, PMP, CAPM, or Agile training, and healthcare IT or HIPAA-regulated data experience.
A self-sufficient, highly organized working style that keeps many projects moving without close oversight, paired with the credibility to connect with frontline medics and firefighters as easily as agency leadership and an eagerness to adopt AI and new tools.

Ready to make an impact?

About Us

Codeword is a communication agency that helps brands create breakthrough comms, content, and community experiences.

We’re a fast-moving team of writers, editors, designers, strategists, videographers, PR mavens, and even a few traditional marketers.

Our incredible roster of global brands trust us to launch their startups, run multi-channel campaigns, grow their user bases, and lead comprehensive PR and marketing initiatives. We're storytellers and brand engineers, and we love big ideas that serve a real purpose.

Codeword is a remote-first agency, with physical offices in NYC and SF that we won’t make you visit.

About You

3+ years of experience in project management
1-2 years of experience in the energy sector (regulatory or commercial)
3+ years of domain experience in Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) and Virtual Power Plants (VPPs)
Excellent organizational and project management skills, with experience managing databases and executing on multiple projects simultaneously
Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage complex strategic and operational initiatives
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build and maintain relationships with external partners
Ability to work across global time zones and drive teams to work toward priority objectives
Ability to self-start and self-direct work in an unstructured environment

About This Role

You’ll be supporting Google’s Energy & Power team, to deliver reliable, scalable energy solutions for Google’s global operations. In this role, you’ll be the link between internal projects and financial operations, guiding work from initial planning through to final invoicing. You’ll keep our financial and business workflows humming along. That means bringing structure to fast-moving requests, and adapting easily when priorities shift, making sure the end result is accurate, compliant, and on time where no one’s left wondering “Wait, what’s the status of this budget?”

If you love connecting dots between strategy, spend, and operational excellence, and are the type to get a small thrill from a perfectly balanced tracker or a streamlined process — you’ll fit right in.

What You’ll Be Doing

Serve as the primary lead for financial operations and business process workflows.
Manage and streamline the end-to-end purchase order (PO) lifecycle and invoicing schedules.
Maintain meticulous trackers, ensuring real-time visibility into project spend versus forecasts.
Identify and implement process improvements to drive operational efficiency and financial compliance.
Schedule meetings and presentations with partners and ensure all logistics are covered. Prepare and distribute clear agendas and capture key takeaways from meetings. Support projects from kickoff to completion, keeping timeline on track

Your Compensation

People – that’s you! – are the heart of our business, and we believe in pay transparency.

Our budget for this role is $115K – $130K depending on experience.

Codeword Benefits

Flexible work hours
Minimum 20 days paid vacation annually
401k + financial wellness support
Health Insurance (medical, dental, life, pet, mental health services)
Home office allowance
Bi-annual Wellness Credits
Monthly Technology Credit (to offset internet / phone costs)
Comprehensive Parental Leave Policy

A Few More Things You Should Know About Codeword

The Codeword dream: Make good money doing work you care about with people you like.
We love our clients (they write the checks!), which means maintaining a high bar for the creativity, smarts, responsiveness, and communication skills we offer them.
We’re around 100 people, big enough to handle large-scale marketing programs, small enough that you’ll have an impact on our culture.
We’re a friendly team, we look after each other, and we grow our careers together.
We respect everyone’s personal life. After-hours emails are strongly frowned upon, night and weekend work is very rare, and employees are encouraged to pursue their side-hustles.
We’re all grownups here, and we trust each other to get the work done, whether at home or in an office or a time zone on the other side of the world.
We believe in defaulting to openness. Our calendars, our salary tiers, and our doors are open for all to see. (Except for secret client stuff, which we guard with our lives.)
We’re a proud member of the global WE Communications family.

Diversity and Inclusion: Codeword works hard to foster a diverse team and an inclusive workplace where everyone thrives.

We aren’t a traditional agency, so we like to hire people who don’t necessarily fit the agency mold or check all the “right” boxes. If you’re on the fence about applying, please do!

KI ist kein Hype, sondern der Schlüssel zu einer besseren Nutzererfahrung.

Unsere KI-Initiativen, wie der S-KIPilot für die Sparkassen-Finanzgruppe, stehen im Zentrum unserer nutzerzentrierten IT- und Geschäftsstrategie. In dieser Rolle werden Technologie, Business und Nutzerbedürfnisse zusammengeführt und sichergestellt, dass KI in Europas größter Finanzgruppe zum strategischen Erfolgsfaktor wird. Hier wird nicht nur Einfluss genommen, sondern neue Standards gesetzt.

Deine Aufgaben:

Werde der Architekt der Zukunft: Übernimm die Leitung (oder Stellvertretende Leitung) innovativer Projekte im Bereich Generative Künstliche Intelligenz, die unsere Branche revolutionieren – von der ersten Idee bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Dabei hast du stets die Nutzer im Fokus, um Lösungen zu entwickeln, die den Menschen das Leben erleichtern.
Inspiriere und motiviere: Führe dein Projekt-Team mit Leidenschaft und einer klaren Vision, sodass jeder einzelne über sich hinauswächst und gemeinsam mit dir Großes erreicht.
Setze neue Standards: Bewältige Herausforderungen und finde kreative Lösungen, die nicht nur die Ziele erreichen, sondern neue Maßstäbe setzen – immer unter Berücksichtigung der Bedürfnisse der Nutzer:innen.
Übernimm die Verantwortung für eine breite Nutzerreichweite: Du trägst die Verantwortung dafür, dass die von dir geleiteten Projekte nicht nur innovativ, sondern auch für eine breite Nutzerschaft zugänglich und relevant sind.
Kommuniziere mit Power: Ob mit deinem Projekt-Team oder mit Führungskräften – du sorgst dafür, dass alle wissen, wohin die Reise geht und warum deine Projekte unaufhaltsam sind. Dabei legst du besonderen Wert auf den Austausch mit den Endnutzer:innen, um sicherzustellen, dass ihre Bedürfnisse erfüllt werden.
Denke weiter und setze neue Maßstäbe: Dein Mut, Neues zu wagen, wird uns dabei unterstützen, die nächste Generation von Künstliche Intelligenz-Lösungen zu entwickeln, die den Nutzer:innen echten Mehrwert bieten.
Arbeite agil und selbstorganisiert: Du bist vertraut mit agilen Methoden und kannst flexibel sowie selbstorganisiert auf neue Anforderungen reagieren. Du treibst eine moderne Arbeitskultur voran, die Raum für Kreativität und schnelle Anpassungen schafft – und so New Work erlebbar macht.

Dein Profil:

Erfahrung, die zählt: Du hast bereits mehrere erfolgreiche Projekte gemanagt und idealerweise Erfahrung im Bereich Generative Künstliche Intelligenz oder IT-Projekte gesammelt.
Bildung und Weitsicht: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Betriebswirtschaft oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation bildet dein Fundament. Generative Künstliche Intelligenz ist dir vertraut, und du kennst Technologien wie Generative Pre-trained Transformers (GPT) und Transformer-Netzwerke – und weißt, wie du sie einsetzen kannst, um nutzerzentrierte Lösungen zu entwickeln. Mind. 6 Jahre fachbezogene Berufserfahrung.
Führungsstärke: Du bist ein echter Leader:in, der mit Entschlossenheit und Weitblick vorangeht. Herausforderungen sind für dich kein Hindernis, sondern eine Einladung, noch besser zu werden.
Agilität im Blut: Agile Methoden sind für dich mehr als nur ein Konzept – sie sind die Grundlage deines Erfolgs und helfen dir, Projekte flexibel und effektiv zu steuern, immer mit Blick auf den Nutzen für die Anwender:innen.
Kommunikation, die bewegt: Du kannst komplexe Themen klar und überzeugend vermitteln und alle Beteiligten mit auf die Reise nehmen, wobei du die Bedürfnisse der Nutzer:innen nie aus den Augen verlierst.
Du strebst nach Exzellenz: Eigeninitiative, Selbstorganisation, kreative Lösungen, der Drang, ständig weiterzukommen, ein positives Mindset und Leidenschaft – das zeichnet dich aus. Dein Wissenshunger und deine Bereitschaft, kontinuierlich zu lernen, treiben dich an, nutzerzentrierte Projekte erfolgreich umzusetzen.

Summary

Mortenson is currently seeking a Engineering Project Manager I/II
that will manage the overall scope, schedule, and budget of engineering projects as well as manage relationships with stakeholders and build a Market portfolio supporting a Mortenson Operating Group. Projects would include the engineering scopes of Wind, Solar, Battery Storage, Substation, T-lines, and Collection Systems with the potential to grow into new operating groups within Mortenson.

This position offers opportunities at both levels 1 and 2, allowing candidates to apply based on their experience and qualifications. Compensation for this role is determined based on factors such as experience and location.

Manage projects

Build and maintain schedules for engineering projects by coordinating with the engineering teams and design phase manager
Facilitate and lead projects including leading the meetings for design team engineers related to project coordination
Learn and use the construction management software tool to manage all phases and aspects of projects including the vendor drawing review process and submittal of the design deliverable packages to the customer.
Manage open engineering project issues to close by deadlines.
Collaborate with design team engineers, design phase managers, and field team project managers to ensure exceptional end-customer experience.

Contract scope administration and management

No-Cost mental health tool and concierge with extensive work-life resources

Adoption Assistance
Gym Membership Discount Program

Engineering Project Manager I

4+ years of related engineering and/or project management experience

jobs.description:
Puget Sound Energy is looking to grow our community with top talented individuals like you! With our rapidly growing, award winning energy efficiency programs, our pathway to an exciting and innovative future is now.

PSE's New Product Development team is looking for qualified candidates to fill an open Project Manager II - Collocation
position!

Specific details regarding the work arrangements for this position will be discussed in further detail during the interview process.

Job Description

The Project Manager II manages wireless radio and antenna installation projects on utility poles throughout PSE's Washington State territory. Working under the guidance of senior staff and Project Manager III, this role coordinates with multiple internal departments (Engineering, Real Estate, Environmental, Permitting, System Planning, and Energy Resources) and external customers to execute defined project scopes. The position involves conducting regular site visits throughout the territory, managing all construction-related activities for wireless projects, drafting and monitoring medium-complexity contracts, and managing contractor relationships to ensure project deliverables meet timelines and quality standards. This role requires strong communication skills, project management experience (preferably in utilities or telecommunications), and the ability to collaborate across departments while maintaining compliance with company standards and regulatory requirements.

Upholds the safety compliance standards inherent in PSE’s operating and/or field procedures related to work responsibilities. Promotes and supports a culture of total safety. Demonstrates commitment to conduct business honestly, ethically and consistent with our core values and Code of Conduct. Ensures duties are performed in accordance with all regulatory compliance obligations.

This job is considered “safety sensitive” as defined in RCW 49.44.240 and is subject to pre-employment drug screening that includes screening for the presence of marijuana and marijuana metabolites.

Job Responsibilities

Coordinates resources, provides oversight and direction to team members.
Identifies the scope of an assigned project and decides logical action to meet project requirements and deadlines.
Communicate and manage the customer relationship as the primary point of contact.
Accurately identify customer needs, set reasonable expectations, identify potential issues and share alternatives.
Facilitates communication between service providers and internal customers, which may include technical support at the direction of a senior project manager.
Responds to customer concerns and works with appropriate parties for resolution.
Facilitates technical assistance to internal and external customers.
Applies general rules, standards and guidelines to specific technical problems.
Reports on project and program progress as directed.
Gathers, consolidates and analyzes facts in relation to project requirements.
Responsible for schedule and budget development, management and forecasting.
Supports emergency response work as requested.
P erforms other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of education and/or work experience.
At least four years relevant work experience including managing simple projects.
Demonstrated strong written and verbal communications skills and ability to work as part of a team.
Basic knowledge and experience in scheduling, estimating, accounting and finance principles.
Basic knowledge in project management discipline to effectively arrange resources and manage multiple simple to medium complexity projects in a cross-functional environment.
Customer-oriented, a positive, team-oriented and collaborative attitude, flexibility, an understanding of the business issues driving the need for the project, and solid work ethic are expected.

Desired Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Project Management or related discipline.
Experience managing small projects or programs.
Strong communication and presentation skills and techniques to bring about agreement between divergent points of view. Ability to write clear, concise and direct narrative and reports.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and conceptual skills for single of multiple technical areas.
Negotiating and critical thinking skills.
Knowledge of utility methods, techniques and procedures involved in budgeting, procurement and contract administration.
Advanced Project Management Training and Project Management or Construction Management Certification from an accredited institution (PMI or College).

Additional Information

At PSE, we value our employees and provide them with opportunities to excel. We offer a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package. To learn more about why PSE is a great place to work, see our Employee Value Proposition , which highlights our commitment to employee growth, work-life balance, and meaningful career opportunities in the energy sector.

The pay range for this position is $82,000.00 - $136,300.00, and this position is eligible for annual goals based incentive bonuses.

PSE offers a suite of benefits to our employees. Employees are eligible for medical, dental, vision, basic life, and short- and long-term disability insurance. There are additional voluntary options of supplemental life insurance, accidental death and dismemberment insurance, flexible spending accounts for health care and dependent daycare, and an Employee assistance program (EAP). For long term savings, PSE offers a 401(k) investment option and a cash balance retirement plan. Employees will also receive Paid Time Off (PTO) and Paid Holidays throughout the calendar year. Detailed benefit overviews can be found on our Career page - Why Work For Us (pse.com) .

Families and businesses depend on PSE to provide the energy they need to pursue their dreams. Our steadfast commitment to serving Washington communities with safe, dependable and efficient energy started in 1873. Today we're building the Northwest's energy future through efforts like our award winning energy efficiency programs and our leadership in renewable energy.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, veteran status or presence of a disability that with or without reasonable accommodation does not prevent performance of the essential functions of the job, or any other category prohibited by local, state or federal law.

8+ years of IT project or program management experience, preferably leading enterprise platform implementations.

401(k) plan and contributions.

Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

La culture d'inclusion d'Amazon est renforcée par nos 16 Principes de Leadership, qui rappellent aux membres de l'équipe de rechercher des perspectives diverses, d'apprendre et de faire preuve de curiosité, et de gagner la confiance. Le poste Souhaitez-vous rejoindre une équipe où vous gérerez l'expansion, l'aménagement et le lancement des opérations de Centres de Distribution (FC) à la pointe de la technologie, qui sont à la base du succès d'Amazon et soutiennent nos clients dans un environnement dynamique et en pleine croissance ?

Avec, en prime, la possibilité de voyager et de travailler dans plusieurs pays et cultures ? Le poste peut être basé n'importe où dans l'UE, avec 50 % du temps consacré à des déplacements liés aux projets, que ce soit au niveau national ou vers d'autres pays de la région EMEA.

En tant que Responsable de Programme Senior expérimenté(e), vous êtes chargé(e) de veiller à ce que les FC soient construits dans les délais et dans le respect du budget, en coordonnant le travail de différentes équipes et parties prenantes. Vous soutiendrez l'expansion continue du réseau de distribution européen d'Amazon, serez responsable de la réussite globale des projets en dirigeant et en influençant des équipes de partenaires commerciaux et de parties prenantes techniques au sein d'une organisation matricielle pour l'exécution des projets sur site. De plus, vous piloterez la stratégie commerciale à long terme grâce à la standardisation au sein de notre réseau. Les candidat(e)s retenu(e)s seront naturellement proactifs/proactives, disposeront de bases solides en Gestion de Projet et auront de l'expérience dans la gestion de grands projets avec des calendriers accélérés. Vous êtes capable de diriger et d'encadrer des ingénieurs de projet, des spécialistes techniques et des chefs de projet dans la coordination des risques et des opportunités en termes de délais, de coûts et de qualité. Vous appréciez d'interagir avec, de piloter et de soutenir à la fois des équipes transverses, des experts du domaine et des individus à tous les niveaux, aussi bien à l'intérieur qu'à l'extérieur des lignes hiérarchiques de l'organisation.

Key job responsibilities

Gérer des projets CAPEX au sein d'une organisation pluridisciplinaire et multiculturelle pour nos opérations de distribution clients
Prise en charge de bout en bout des livrables des projets d'entrepôt
Planification intégrée des projets, planification des ressources, analyse du chemin critique et optimisation du calendrier de l'ensemble des activités commerciales, techniques, financières et programmatiques sur plusieurs projets
À l'aise dans différents rôles et capable de communiquer et de travailler efficacement avec des experts en Construction, Ingénierie, Opérations, Finance, Achats, Transport ou Droit des contrats
Coordonner de multiples calendriers interdépendants de flux de matériaux et d'installation des fournisseurs
Travailler aux côtés des fournisseurs et des services achats pour gérer les bons de commande
Maintenir une cadence régulière avec les équipes internes et les fournisseurs pour planifier et suivre les livrables
Suivi et communication continus de l'état d'avancement des projets, remontée ciblée et opportune des risques et problèmes potentiels auprès de plusieurs équipes et des parties prenantes du projet
Travailler de manière indépendante et autonome dans un environnement dynamique et en évolution rapide

A day in the life

Vous planifierez et exécuterez le business case qui permet de livrer des centres de distribution opérationnels. Votre journée pourrait inclure des échanges avec tous les niveaux de l'organisation pour convenir d'une stratégie, vous rendre sur le site et prendre en charge son développement, d'un terrain nu (greenfield) jusqu'à un FC pleinement fonctionnel, planifier et gérer les ressources pour exécuter les activités que vous aurez détaillées dans un calendrier de bout en bout. Vous prendrez des décisions au nom de l'entreprise et verrez leurs résultats se concrétiser grâce à la coordination des parties prenantes, internes comme externes, pour enfin célébrer le lancement réussi de l'installation… le Jour Un pour nous tous !

About The Team

L'équipe EU Startup est composée d'un groupe talentueux de chefs de projet et de programme qui pilotent la coordination de toutes les activités nécessaires à la construction, en toute sécurité, de FC hautement complexes conformes aux standards du réseau sur l'ensemble du marché de l'UE. Notre équipe accorde une grande importance à l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée et nous nous consacrons au développement et au soutien de nos nouveaux membres. Cela permet aux Chefs de Projet/Programme de respecter des délais exigeants et des budgets frugaux pour livrer rapidement des projets de construction neuve, d'expansion et de rénovation découlant des besoins en capacité, en stock, en automatisation et en durabilité, afin d'améliorer l'expérience client, de réduire les coûts et d'optimiser le réseau de distribution d'Amazon.

Basic Qualifications

Diplôme de licence (Bachelor) en management, administration des affaires, économie, ingénierie ou marketing
Expérience de travail transverse avec des équipes techniques et non techniques
Expérience en gestion de comptes, gestion de projet/programme ou achats
Expérience dans l'élaboration et la mise en œuvre de standards, de politiques et de programmes, ou équivalent
Expérience de la prise en charge de la stratégie de programme, de la livraison de bout en bout et de la communication des résultats à la direction senior
Parler, écrire et lire couramment l'anglais au niveau C1 ou supérieur
Management, coaching et développement de managers, d'équipes et de ressources de projet
Gestion de projets d'infrastructure
Maîtrise des produits Microsoft Office : Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint et MS Project
Expérience de base avec un logiciel de CAO (par ex. AutoCAD, Solid Works ou autre)

Preferred Qualifications

Expérience de la communication avec un large éventail de parties prenantes, y compris des collègues et la direction, ou expérience de la gestion d'équipes
Expérience de la réalisation de tâches complexes rapidement avec peu ou pas d'accompagnement et capacité à réagir avec l'urgence appropriée aux situations nécessitant un traitement rapide, ou expérience de la gestion d'équipes
Expérience dans un environnement logistique/opérationnel
Certification Project Management Professional (PMP) ou équivalente
Expérience dans des tâches ou environnements commerciaux, ou expérience avec les produits et applications Microsoft Office
Parler, écrire et lire couramment le français et l'anglais au niveau C1 ou supérieur
Expérience dans l'e-commerce, le retail ou la publicité,

Job Description:

GDIT is seeking a Program Manager - Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS) / Counter-Unmanned Aerial Systems (CUAS) to lead the delivery of enterprise-scale capabilities that protect personnel, facilities, and operations.

The Program Manager will integrate strategy, governance, acquisition support, systems engineering, operations, training, sustainment, compliance, and stakeholder engagement into a unified program that supports mission objectives. Success requires experience leading complex UAS and CUAS programs, advancing organizational capabilities, integrating emerging technologies, and driving operational adoption across large federal environments.

HOW A PROGRAM MANAGER - UAS / CUAS WILL MAKE AN IMPACT

Strategic Leadership & Branch Program Governance

Develop and execute multi-year program strategies, capability roadmaps, implementation plans, and performance metrics aligned to mission priorities.
Advise Government leadership on investments, resource requirements, risks, and opportunities to expand and optimize UAS/CUAS capabilities.
Lead an integrated program management structure that aligns technical, operational, acquisition, logistics, security, training, and financial activities.
Establish effective governance, executive reporting, risk management, integrated scheduling, and performance tracking processes.

Program Delivery & Capability Advancement

Direct the full lifecycle delivery of UAS and CUAS initiatives, including development requirements, market research, testing, fielding, operations, sustainment, and continuous improvement.
Advance organizational capability maturity through assessments, gap analysis, workforce planning, process development, and operational integration.
Develop and maintain concepts of operations, standard operating procedures, deployment plans, readiness criteria, lifecycle management processes, and configuration controls.
Manage concurrent efforts across multiple stakeholders and locations while maintaining alignment to cost, schedule, performance, security, and mission objectives.
Lead change management, communications, and knowledge transfer activities that support durable mission outcomes.

Technology Integration, Evaluation & Vendor Management

Support evaluation, selection, integration, and sustainment of UAS/CUAS sensors, command-and-control systems, communications, effectors, data services, and supporting infrastructure.
Apply expertise across leading UAS/CUAS hardware, software, integration, and service providers to inform technology decisions.
Establish requirements traceability, technical evaluation criteria, interoperability objectives, acceptance standards, and modernization roadmaps.
Coordinate demonstrations, pilots, operational assessments, testing activities, technical interchange meetings, and after-action reviews.
Manage subcontractor and OEM relationships, including performance, integration dependencies, licensing, sustainment, and supply-chain considerations.

Operations, Readiness, Training & Sustainment

Develop scalable operational models supporting fixed-site, mobile, expeditionary, and event-driven mission requirements, as authorized by the Government.
Establish readiness reporting, maintenance planning, configuration management, asset accountability, technical documentation, and sustainment processes.
Develop training, qualifications, exercise, and proficiency programs for operators, maintainers, analysts, and program personnel.
Implement operational reporting, lessons learned, incident response, and continuous improvement processes to enhance mission effectiveness.
Plan and oversee long-term sustainment and operational support across geographically dispersed locations.

Security, Safety, Policy & Risk Management

Ensure compliance with applicable federal laws, policies, aviation and spectrum requirements, cybersecurity controls, privacy considerations, records management obligations, export controls, and authorities governing CUAS operations.
Collaborate with legal, policy, security, acquisition, intelligence, aviation, cybersecurity, spectrum, facilities, and operational stakeholders to resolve constraints and support program execution.
Integrate cybersecurity, supply-chain risk management, physical security, operational security, system assurance, and safety practices throughout the program lifecycle.
Lead risk management, contingency planning, audit support, corrective actions, and executive-level risk communication.

Financial, Acquisition & Workforce Management

Manage program financial performance, staffing, resource allocation, subcontractor oversight, forecasting, and execution against established baselines.
Support acquisition activities, including market research, technical requirements development, statements of work, evaluation criteria, cost inputs, source selection support, and post-award oversight.
Recruit, develop, and lead multidisciplinary teams spanning program management, operations, engineering, cybersecurity, logistics, training, integration, and field support.
Foster a culture of accountability, safety, compliance, collaboration, innovation, and mission excellence.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO SUCCEED

Education

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, aviation, computer science, cybersecurity, systems engineering, business, program management, or a related discipline required; master’s degree preferred.

Experience

12+ years of progressively responsible program leadership experience supporting complex federal technology, security, aviation, defense, or mission operations programs.

UAS / CUAS Leadership

5+ years leading UAS, CUAS, airspace security, or closely related programs, including demonstrated experience maturing at least one program, office, branch, or enterprise capability from initial concept through sustained operations.

Federal Agency Experience

Demonstrated success advising and supporting a large federal department or agency as it matured UAS / CUAS capabilities, governance, workforce, policy, technology, and operational processes.

Program Scale

Experience leading multidisciplinary, multi-contractor teams; geographically dispersed operations; complex stakeholder environments; and concurrent technical and operational workstreams.

Technical Experience

Working knowledge of UAS / CUAS architectures, sensors, command-and-control, integration, communications, data, testing, deployment, training, logistics, and lifecycle sustainment. Direct experience with solutions from the named providers or comparable industry platforms is strongly preferred.

Acquisition & Compliance

Experience supporting federal acquisition and vendor management and operating within applicable safety, aviation, spectrum, cybersecurity, privacy, supply-chain, and legal/policy constraints.

Certifications

Project Management Professional (PMP) required or must be obtained within an employer-defined period. Relevant UAS, aviation, systems engineering, cybersecurity, or acquisition credentials are preferred.

Executive Communication

Exceptional ability to communicate complex technical, operational, policy, and risk matters to senior Government executives, operational users, contracting officials, and industry partners.

Security Clearance

Current, in-scope investigation allowing ability to obtain a Top Secret clearance.

Location & Travel

National Capital Region hybrid presence with regular on-site customer engagement. CONUS and OCONUS travel is expected, including travel to operational sites, demonstrations, exercises, and industry locations.

PREFERRED DIFFERENTIATORS

Experience developing enterprise UAS / CUAS strategies and roadmaps across both domestic and international operating environments.
Experience with open architecture, multi-vendor integration, technology insertion, test and evaluation, and transition from pilot to sustained operations.
Experience building Government workforce proficiency and transferring program knowledge, data, processes, and technical baselines to federal personnel.
Experience managing sensitive operational technologies and coordinating among legal, policy, intelligence, law-enforcement, aviation, cybersecurity, acquisition, and customer stakeholders.

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Inference
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

About The Team

The AI/ML TPM team owns delivery and execution across CoreWeave’s AI/ML Platform Services organization. The team partners closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Infrastructure, and Go-to-Market teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and high-performance platforms that support the full AI lifecycle. AI/ML TPMs drive alignment and execution across highly technical, cross-functional teams to ensure the successful delivery of customer-facing infrastructure and platform capabilities used by researchers, engineers, and enterprise customers.

About The Role

CoreWeave’s AI/ML Platform Services organization builds the distributed systems that power large-scale inference workloads across our GPU-accelerated cloud. As a Technical Program Manager focused on inference, you will lead complex, cross-functional programs spanning inference platform delivery, customer onboarding, launch readiness, and runtime optimization.

The Inference team is responsible for building and operating highly scalable, reliable production inference services for both serverless and dedicated inference use cases. The work spans platform reliability, operational excellence, customer onboarding, release validation, runtime performance, and the launch of new inference capabilities that help customers run models at scale with strong price-performance and low operational friction.

In this role, you will partner with engineering, product, infrastructure, and go-to-market teams to drive programs that improve how inference services are launched, onboarded, operated, and optimized. This includes managing the execution of customer-facing onboarding programs, launch readiness for dedicated inference capabilities, and the platform improvements needed to support scale, reliability, and predictable delivery.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in complex, cross-functional environments, has deep technical fluency in distributed systems, inference infrastructure, and AI platform operations, and excels at creating structure, visibility, and execution rhythm across multiple teams.

What You’ll Do

Drive end-to-end program management for inference platform initiatives spanning reliability, customer onboarding, launch readiness, and runtime optimization.
Lead cross-functional programs for customer onboarding across dedicated and serverless inference offerings, ensuring clear ownership, launch criteria, and readiness for strategic customer use cases.
Drive launch readiness for new inference capabilities by aligning teams around real customer outcomes, supportability, and end-to-end validation.
Partner with engineering and product to define and deliver roadmap outcomes for latency, throughput, uptime, operational quality, and price-performance.
Coordinate multi-team execution across platform, infrastructure, and customer-facing teams to deliver reliable and scalable inference services.
Build and operationalize success metrics, dashboards, launch gates, and review cadences to measure service reliability, onboarding readiness, efficiency, and quality across the inference stack.
Establish repeatable processes for release validation, performance regression tracking, launch management, and postmortem follow-through.
Help unify operational processes, support mechanisms, and execution visibility across inference deployment models and customer onboarding paths.
Create strong communication channels between Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, and Go-to-Market teams to align priorities and deliver predictable, high-impact outcomes.

Who You Are

Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
8+ years of technical program management experience in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or AI/ML platform engineering.
Proven experience driving large-scale infrastructure or platform programs from concept to production in complex, cross-functional environments.
Strong technical fluency in distributed inference systems, GPU compute, cloud-native architectures, and performance optimization.
Demonstrated success driving measurable improvements in reliability, performance, operational readiness, or customer delivery.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to align engineering, product, infrastructure, and customer-facing stakeholders around shared goals.
Experience with inference-serving systems, model onboarding workflows, rollout strategies, and observability tooling.
Familiarity with launch readiness, supportability, incident follow-through, and release validation for production infrastructure or platform services.
Understanding of customer onboarding for technical products, especially where platform capabilities, infrastructure readiness, and support processes must align for launch.
Experience operating in high-growth environments where roadmap execution, reliability expectations, and customer commitments must be managed in parallel.

Wondering if you’re a good fit?

We believe in investing in our people and value candidates who bring diverse experiences to our teams—even if you aren’t a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.

You love driving execution for complex, customer-facing AI infrastructure and platform programs.
You’re curious about how large-scale inference systems evolve across runtime performance, operational excellence, and customer onboarding.
You’re effective at creating clarity and momentum across ambiguous, fast-moving multi-team initiatives.
You enjoy turning technically complex platform work into predictable execution and successful launches.

Why CoreWeave?

About

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

Be Curious at Your Core
Act Like an Owner
Empower Employees
Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and provides the opportunity to develop innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

What We Offer

The range we’ve posted represents the typical compensation range for this role. To determine actual compensation, we review the market rate for each candidate which can include a variety of factors. These include qualifications, experience, interview performance, and location.

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our US-based offerings for full-time employees; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include:

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Hardware Modules
jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Waymo’s Technical Program Managers and Program Managers are accountable for Waymo’s roadmap execution by providing thoughtful cross-functional planning, clarity, and proactive risk management. In the face of complex technical and operational challenges with no established playbooks to follow, we act with thoughtful urgency, driving conversations, discussions, and outcomes. Our team partners closely with every function of Waymo to structure, own and drive work towards real-world deployments of the Waymo Driver across platforms and geographies.

This role follows a hybrid work schedule and reports to the Technical Program Manager, Hardware.

You Will

Own end-to-end program management for next gen lidar and other sensing and compute modules (e.g., cameras, telematics) from concept through Proto, EVT, DVT, PVT and handover to operations
Build and drive detailed, bottoms-up schedules with cross-functional dependencies and long-lead items; identify when work is off track and drive recovery plans
Own the prototype build plan and build readiness (materials, line and test readiness, quality), publish build reports, and drive issues to closure
Drive design releases, design reviews (EE/ME/FW, DFM/DFA, DFMEA/PFMEA, EMC, SI/PI, thermal) and phase-gate reviews with Engineering, Reliability, DV, Systems and Vehicle Integration teams
Manage technical relationships with suppliers and contract manufacturers in partnership with Global Supply Management: SOWs, build schedules, open-issue lists and supplier performance
Own the program risk register and communicate status, risks and decisions clearly to stakeholders and leadership through weekly updates and program reviews

The AI/ML TPM team owns delivery and execution across CoreWeave’s AI/ML Platform Services organization. The team partners closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Infrastructure, and Go-to-Market teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and high-performance platforms that support the full AI lifecycle. jobs.description:
About Veeco

You probably don’t realize it, but what we do at Veeco touches the lives of every person, every day. It’s a bold statement, but it’s true. From the smartphones in our pockets that access the world’s collective knowledge, to the cloud-based services where all that information lives, to high-speed wireless communication and computing power needed to drive artificial intelligence, augmented and virtual reality, gaming and so much more, our technology is all around us.

We design, develop, manufacture, and service highly complex, cutting-edge machines used by our customers to create the essential devices that drive the digital age, connect the world, and improve the human experience. Along with the world’s leading technology companies, many of which are household names, we help solve their most difficult material science challenges, enabling technologies for a more connected, sustainable, and convenient world.

We’re looking for material difference-makers to join our growing team. Interested? Learn more at www.veeco.com/careers .

Overview

Veeco's complex semiconductor equipment programs require disciplined coordination across engineering, supply chain, operations, and customer-facing teams to move new technology from concept to qualified product. As Program Manager, you will lead multidisciplinary programs through design, engineering release, procurement, system integration, testing, qualification, and lifecycle milestones. Your decisions will directly influence schedule performance, product cost, technical readiness, quality, and customer commitments for advanced vacuum process equipment. You will create the operating rhythm, visibility, and cross-functional alignment that enable teams to resolve risk early and deliver reliable products to market.

Responsibilities

Own multiple complex engineering and product-development programs from concept through product release, aligning technical scope, schedule, cost, quality, and customer objectives.
Build and maintain integrated program plans that identify milestones, dependencies, critical-path activities, decision points, and recovery actions.
Drive cross-functional decisions across mechanical, electrical, systems, software, process engineering, operations, supply chain, technical support, and field service teams.
Anticipate program risks and lead clear mitigation or recovery plans that protect engineering releases, long-lead procurement, system builds, integration, testing, and qualification milestones.
Establish concise program reviews and dashboards that give engineering and executive leaders timely visibility into schedule performance, milestone variance, cost, technical readiness, and unresolved decisions.
Control product configuration and lifecycle execution by coordinating engineering change orders, bills of material, documentation releases, continuous improvement activities, and customer-specific engineering requirements.
Manage program budgets, product-cost targets, resource needs, and costed bills of material in partnership with functional leaders and supply chain teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in engineering, engineering management, or a related technical discipline.
5+ years of experience in engineering, project management, or technical program management for complex equipment or hardware products.
Experience leading multidisciplinary programs that include mechanical, electrical, software, systems, manufacturing, and supply chain workstreams.
Experience managing product development through engineering release, procurement, system integration, testing, and qualification.
Experience independently managing multiple programs with competing schedules, resources, and priorities.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Skilled at translating complex technical work into integrated schedules, critical-path analysis, measurable milestones, and practical recovery plans.
Working knowledge of semiconductor capital equipment, vacuum processing systems, or other complex manufacturing equipment.
Proficiency with engineering change control, bills of material, product configuration, and product lifecycle processes.
Ability to evaluate technical and business trade-offs, clarify decision ownership, and guide cross-functional teams toward timely resolution.
Skilled at presenting concise program status, risks, priorities, and decisions to engineers, suppliers, customers, and senior leaders.
Experience with enterprise resource planning and product lifecycle management systems, such as SAP, and scheduling tools such as Microsoft Project or Smartsheet.
Project Management Professional certification or experience with customer-specific and engineer-to-order programs is preferred.

Salary And Benefits

The expected salary range for this position is $106,548.00 — $142,064.00, plus a bonus opportunity. We will consider your location, experience, and other job-related factors when determining your pay.

Commuter Benefits

Master’s degree in a related technical field or a Master of Business Administration (MBA).
Experience managing Department of Defense, U.S. government, allied‑defense, or prime‑contractor programs.

Experience managing programs from development through qualification and production.

In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. Position Summary

Thales has a vacancy for a Deputy Program Manager (DPM) – Program Enablement
who will be accountable for defining and executing the strategic digital transformation vision and roadmap for the AJISS Program, ensuring alignment between operational requirements, contractual commitments, enterprise objectives, and future business growth opportunities while influencing executive decision-making across multiple organizational functions. One of the key strategic goals in the AJISS Program is to enable vessel mission readiness and availability of vessels required by the Royal Canadian Navy (RCN). This role demands a highly developed communication skills to lead collaboratively in a cross-functional working environment.

Thales delivers on schedule, cost, scope, and quality requirements to the satisfaction of the Client. The ability to collaboratively lead, direct, motivate, and engage integrated project teams will be key to success. Accountable for shaping the future-state operating model for Program Enablement across AJISS, ensuring digital systems, business processes, and organizational capabilities are aligned to support long-term operational readiness, contract execution excellence, and sustainable growth.

The current work scope anticipated for the DPM – Program Enablement is to develop the systems and processes required for improved efficiency and effectiveness across the AJISS Program. This role requires strategic planning and strong implementation focus and constantly looking forward to improving and driving value in AJISS Program business processes using enhanced technologies. It demands strong systems thinking, project management skills, an excellent management of relationships, and the use of highly developed networking and influencing skills. Core elements required for success in this role include the ability to provide clear direction, create alignment across multiple project teams, and develop a critical sense of urgency to focus efforts on delivering value.

The DPM – Program Enablement reports directly to the Program Manager, AJISS and works with an extended team collaboratively to deliver systems and processes that enhance and create value for Thales’ Customers. jobs.description:
Job Description

This Opportunity

WSP is seeking an experienced Program Manager
to support a major transit agency in New York City
on large-scale fare payment, transit technology, and customer-facing mobility programs. This position will serve as the primary day-to-day project management lead, coordinating activities among clients, technology vendors, contractors, systems integrators, and stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.

The successful candidate will provide leadership in project planning, schedule management, stakeholder coordination, risk management, executive reporting, governance, implementation oversight, and transition planning for complex transit technology programs. The role is comparable to WSP's support of major fare payment and transit modernization initiatives across New York, Philadelphia, Chicago, San Francisco, and Miami.

This position requires a proven leader with extensive experience managing large, multi-disciplinary transportation technology programs, fare payment systems, account-based ticketing, open payments, customer technology platforms, and systems integration efforts. Candidates should possess strong client relationship skills and experience working directly with executive leadership at large public transportation agencies. Desired qualifications align closely with leadership experience supporting major transit fare modernization and payment system programs, including OMNY and similar initiatives.

Required Work Location

This position is required to be onsite in New York, NY five (5) days per week.

Candidates must reside in or be willing to relocate to the New York City metropolitan area. Remote or hybrid arrangements are not anticipated for this role.

Position is contingent upon contract award.

Your Impact

Serve as Program Manager for major fare collection, transit technology, customer payment, and mobility projects.
Act as the primary WSP point of contact with client executives, technology vendors, contractors, and project stakeholders.
Lead project planning, execution, monitoring, control, and reporting activities throughout the project lifecycle.
Develop and maintain integrated master schedules, budgets, action item logs, risk registers, issue logs, and executive dashboards.
Coordinate activities among agency staff, technology providers, systems integrators, contractors, and subcontractors.
Facilitate executive steering committee meetings, stakeholder workshops, technical reviews, and governance meetings.
Monitor project performance and proactively identify schedule, budget, operational, and technical risks requiring management attention.
Prepare executive-level presentations, briefing materials, program updates, and Board-level reports.
Support project testing, system acceptance, operational readiness, implementation, transition planning, and go-live activities.
Lead stakeholder engagement, communications, and change management efforts.
Oversee vendor performance and coordinate cross-functional teams across technology, operations, finance, customer experience, and engineering disciplines.
Support procurement activities, contract administration, business case development, and strategic planning initiatives.
Mentor project managers and technical staff supporting major transit technology programs.
Support business development, capture planning, proposal development, and client relationship management activities.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Business Administration, Transportation, Construction Management, Planning, or a related field.
Minimum 15 years of progressively responsible project and program management experience.
Minimum 10 years managing large-scale transit, transportation technology, fare collection, intelligent transportation systems (ITS), payment systems, or technology implementation programs.
Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with budgets exceeding $50 million.
Experience overseeing system integration, software development, hardware deployment, testing, and implementation activities.
Strong program controls, risk management, governance, and reporting experience.
Proven ability to lead large, cross-functional teams and coordinate multiple concurrent workstreams.
Exceptional written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience preparing executive briefings and presenting to senior leadership and agency executives.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and project management tools.

Preferred Qualifications

PMP Certification required or strongly preferred.
MBA or advanced degree in a related discipline.
Experience with fare payment systems, Automated Fare Collection (AFC), Account-Based Ticketing (ABT), contactless payments, open-loop payments, mobile ticketing, and transit retailing technologies.
Experience supporting major metropolitan transit agencies, including NYCT/MTA, SEPTA, CTA, MBTA, WMATA, Metra, NJ TRANSIT, SFMTA, BART, or similar agencies.
Experience supporting programs involving payment modernization, fare transformation, customer technology, and digital mobility services.
Familiarity with PMBOK project management practices and governance frameworks.
Experience using Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, Jira, Smartsheet, or similar project controls tools.
Understanding of systems engineering, software lifecycle management, cybersecurity, testing and commissioning, and operational readiness processes.
Experience with procurement support, DBOM/DBFOM contracts, or public-sector technology procurements.
Demonstrated success managing programs involving multiple vendors, contractors, and technology partners.
Existing relationships and experience working with large transit agencies and executive stakeholders.

The ideal candidate will have successfully delivered major transit technology and payment transformation programs involving:

Contactless fare payment systems.
Open payment and account-based ticketing solutions.
Mobile applications and customer-facing technology platforms.
Transit operations technology deployments.
Systems integration and modernization initiatives.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Our purpose is taking care of life’s essentials, but we’re also big on making a difference, not just because we should but because we care.

AMP8, our current five-year regulatory period, will deliver nearly £13bn of investment, of which £6bn will be delivered through our capital programme.

Plug and Play enables Capital Delivery designers to save time and reduce costs through engineering-led, modular solutions – driving transformation, standardising products, and supporting key projects through targeted collaboration.

This innovative programme aims to tackle challenges in waste and water infrastructure, flooding, and water quality – bringing lasting benefits to communities, public health, and the environment.

This is an opportunity to work on high-impact engineering challenges
and influence the future of infrastructure delivery.

We are looking for a Technical Project Manager to work within our Plug & Play team, truly delivering for the future.

LET’S CUT STRAIGHT TO IT

We are looking for a Technical Project Manager
with strong experience in delivering complex infrastructure and engineering projects
to join our innovative Plug & Play team.

This is a delivery-focused role where you will lead the coordination and execution of standardised, repeatable solutions for major infrastructure programmes, supporting one of the UK’s largest capital investment initiatives.

You’ll play a key role in shaping how we plan, manage, and deliver projects smarter, faster, and more efficiently, ensuring solutions are well-defined, buildable, cost-effective, and aligned across multidisciplinary teams.

You will be responsible for delivering projects to programme, within budget, and to the required quality standards, while driving collaboration between engineering, design, and delivery teams.

Be part of developing the future delivery function!

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be ensuring that appropriate project management
input is provided to the project team, enabling effective coordination between the Severn Trent Product Team and Site Design Teams to support successful delivery and installation of standard solutions on site.

Project Leadership & Delivery

Lead the planning and delivery of projects, with a strong focus on:
Programme management and scheduling
Budget control and cost management
Coordination of multidisciplinary engineering and delivery teams

Manage projects from concept through to delivery and handover
Ensure clear governance, reporting, and decision-making throughout the project lifecycle
Drive consistency in delivery across multiple projects and workstreams

Technical Oversight

Support teams to deliver solutions that are practical, buildable, and aligned with project requirements
Review and challenge inputs from designers, consultants, and contractors
Coordinate teams to ensure compliance with applicable standards, specifications, and regulatory requirements
Facilitate resolution of technical issues through collaboration with engineering teams

Innovation & Standardisation

Support the implementation and rollout of repeatable / standard product solutions
Drive efficiency through improved processes, lessons learned, and continuous improvement
Promote standardisation to enhance delivery speed, cost efficiency, and quality outcomes
Contribute to development of delivery frameworks, processes, and best practices

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

Work closely with internal teams, contractors, suppliers, and external stakeholders
Act as the key interface between product, design, and delivery teams
Ensure alignment across all parties to achieve project objectives
Support effective communication and coordination throughout the project lifecycle

Risk & Quality Management

Identify, manage, and mitigate project and delivery risks
Ensure projects meet requirements for health & safety (CDM), programme, cost, constructability, delivery, and whole-life quality performance
Drive a culture of accountability, safety, and continuous improvement

WHAT WE'ER LOOKING FOR

Skills and experience matter, but character and attitude are just as important. We value proactive, positive people who genuinely care, take initiative, and go beyond expectations through their actions, not just their words.

Essential Experience

Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline (or equivalent experience)
Significant experience delivering complex infrastructure or engineering projects, particularly:
Multidisciplinary project coordination
Capital project delivery across design and construction phases
Delivery of modular or standardised solutions (desirable but not essential)

Strong working knowledge of:
Project delivery methodologies (e.g. waterfall, stage-gate, or agile where applicable)
Commercial and cost management principles
Programme planning and scheduling tools

Experience managing consultants, contractors, and external stakeholders
Proven ability to drive projects forward, resolve issues, and deliver practical outcomes

Level

Ideally operating at Senior Project Manager level, but strong Project Managers / Advanced professionals will be considered

Key Attributes

Delivery-focused with strong problem-solving mindset
Innovative and open to new ways of working
Highly collaborative with strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills
Proactive, organised, and able to manage competing priorities

Desirable

Experience in water, wastewater, or infrastructure sectors
Exposure to standardised, modular, or product-based delivery approaches
Understanding of CDM regulations and project delivery responsibilities
Professional certification (e.g. APM, PRINCE2, PMP) or working towards
Experience driving cost optimisation, efficiencies, or value-led delivery

Skills and experience are important, but character, positivity, and a caring attitude matter too. We seek people who get involved, want to be part of something bigger, and make a difference because they care.

How We’ll Reward And Care For You

Working here isn’t just a job. You can build a career at Severn Trent. We’ll reward you for it, too. We have a range of benefits that recognise great work, and award-winning training to help you reach your potential. And we’ll also help you play your part in looking after the environment and the communities where we live.

With That In Mind, Here Are Just Some Of Our Favourite's Perks That You’ll Get Being Part Of The Severn Trent Family

28 days holiday + bank holidays (and the ability to buy/ sell up to 5 days per year)
Annual bonus scheme (of up to £2,250 of base salary per annum based on company performance)
Leading pension scheme – we will double your contribution (up to 15% when you contribute 7.5%)
Sharesave – the chance to buy Severn Trent Plc shares at a discounted rate
Dedicated training and development with our ‘Academy’
Electric vehicle scheme and retail offers
Family friendly policies

Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

The following position is to join our RTX Corporate, Enterprise Services Data organization:

As a Senior Technical Project Manager, Data & AI Delivery

Reporting to the Associate Director of Data and AI, you will collaborate with Enterprise Services Data teams, RTX corporate functions, and Business Unit (BU) stakeholders to shape data and AI priorities, lead strategic initiatives, and drive engagement and adoption of Enterprise Services Data products. Leveraging technologies such as ontology, data products, semantic layers, and AI, you will help advance the Corporate Data Office's strategy and deliver scalable solutions that improve business performance and decision-making. Success in this role requires an AI-first mindset, strong technical and project management capabilities, and the ability to influence and coordinate cross-functional teams to drive execution and measurable business outcomes.

What You Will Do

Lead complex, enterprise-scale data and AI initiatives from planning through development, deployment, and delivery across RTX corporate functions.
Partner with Enterprise Services and Business Unit teams to define data and AI priorities, align strategic objectives, and drive engagement and adoption of enterprise data products.

Identify opportunities to transition manual processes to scalable digital and AI-enabled solutions through incremental, multi-generational roadmaps.
Monitor data integrity, quality, pipeline performance, and system reliability, identifying and resolving issues that impact successful delivery.

Qualifications You Must Have

Typically requires a Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience and a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience, or an Advanced Degree in a related field and a minimum of 7 years of relevant experience.
Experience managing complex, large-scale data and AI initiatives across multiple teams and stakeholders.

Experience with large-scale application architecture, enterprise systems, and integration patterns.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or AWS, Kubernetes, and AI technologies.
Experience leading teams through digital transformation initiatives using Agile development methodologies and Scrum practices.

Hands-on experience designing, developing, and optimizing SQL stored procedures, views, and queries, including performance tuning in Databricks and Snowflake.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including diagnosing data integrity and quality issues, pipeline failures, and performance bottlenecks.
Strong understanding of the software development and engineering lifecycle, from solution conception through development, integration, and delivery.

Experience shaping product roadmaps and partnering with product owners and engineering teams to deliver enterprise data and AI products.
Experience developing incremental, multi-generational technology roadmaps that transition manual processes into digital and AI-enabled solutions.

Ability to prioritize competing demands, assess business value, and focus resources on the highest-impact initiatives.
Strong communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and resolve conflicts across cross-functional teams.

Learn More & Apply Now!
