Engineering program execution: Plan and track technical scope, schedules, milestones, staffing, and deliverables across multi-disciplinary engineering teams.
Technical leadership and integration: Understand FSO product development well enough to coordinate system, optical, electrical, mechanical, software, and test work; identify dependencies; and drive timely decisions.
Risk and stakeholder management: Identify technical and program risks, develop mitigation plans, communicate status clearly to program leadership and customers, and ensure action items are driven to closure.

What sets you apart:

Proven communication and ability to interface with internal and customer leadership
Advanced knowledge of technologies, principles, theories and concepts
Fosters an environment to motivate and push for professional development for yourself and others
Strategically manages risks, opportunities, and conflict resolution.
Identifies opportunities to apply AI for continuous improvement and innovation

Our Commitment to You:

An exciting career path with opportunities for continuous learning and development.
Research oriented work, alongside award winning teams developing practical solutions for our nation’s security
Flexible schedules with every other Friday off work, if desired (9/80 schedule)
Competitive benefits, including 401k matching, flex time off, paid parental leave, healthcare benefits, health & wellness programs, employee resource and social groups, and more

Core Competencies

Execution: Analyzes and prioritizes the varying aspects of the role, knows and/or follows the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, and consistently achieves results, even under tough circumstances.
Collaboration: Builds partnerships and works collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives through effective communication that understands the unique needs of different audiences.
Innovation: Creates new and better ways for the organization to be successful, anticipates and adopts innovations in business, operations, and technology applications.
Adaptability: Adapts and pivots in real time to match the shifting demands of different situations, and moves forward productively and optimistically under conditions of change and ambiguity.

You Must Have

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Robotics, Systems Engineering) or a related technical field.
3+ years of project or program management experience in technical project management, robotics, mechatronics, or electromechanical system deployments.

Strong interpersonal and communication skills for engaging with technical teams and customer stakeholders.

CAPM, PMP, or Agile certification.

new_jobs.description:
Our purpose is taking care of life’s essentials, but we’re also big on making a difference, not just because we should but because we care.

AMP8, our current five-year regulatory period, will deliver nearly £13bn of investment, of which £6bn will be delivered through our capital programme.

Plug and Play enables Capital Delivery designers to save time and reduce costs through engineering-led, modular solutions – driving transformation, standardising products, and supporting key projects through targeted collaboration.

This innovative programme aims to tackle challenges in waste and water infrastructure, flooding, and water quality – bringing lasting benefits to communities, public health, and the environment.

This is an opportunity to work on high-impact engineering challenges
and influence the future of infrastructure delivery.

We are looking for a Technical Project Manager to work within our Plug & Play team, truly delivering for the future.

LET’S CUT STRAIGHT TO IT

We are looking for a Technical Project Manager
with strong experience in delivering complex infrastructure and engineering projects
to join our innovative Plug & Play team.

This is a delivery-focused role where you will lead the coordination and execution of standardised, repeatable solutions for major infrastructure programmes, supporting one of the UK’s largest capital investment initiatives.

You’ll play a key role in shaping how we plan, manage, and deliver projects smarter, faster, and more efficiently, ensuring solutions are well-defined, buildable, cost-effective, and aligned across multidisciplinary teams.

You will be responsible for delivering projects to programme, within budget, and to the required quality standards, while driving collaboration between engineering, design, and delivery teams.

Be part of developing the future delivery function!

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be ensuring that appropriate project management
input is provided to the project team, enabling effective coordination between the Severn Trent Product Team and Site Design Teams to support successful delivery and installation of standard solutions on site.

Lead the planning and delivery of projects, with a strong focus on:
Programme management and scheduling
Budget control and cost management
Coordination of multidisciplinary engineering and delivery teams

Manage projects from concept through to delivery and handover
Ensure clear governance, reporting, and decision-making throughout the project lifecycle
Drive consistency in delivery across multiple projects and workstreams

Technical Oversight

Support teams to deliver solutions that are practical, buildable, and aligned with project requirements
Review and challenge inputs from designers, consultants, and contractors
Coordinate teams to ensure compliance with applicable standards, specifications, and regulatory requirements
Facilitate resolution of technical issues through collaboration with engineering teams

Innovation & Standardisation

Support the implementation and rollout of repeatable / standard product solutions
Drive efficiency through improved processes, lessons learned, and continuous improvement
Promote standardisation to enhance delivery speed, cost efficiency, and quality outcomes
Contribute to development of delivery frameworks, processes, and best practices

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

Work closely with internal teams, contractors, suppliers, and external stakeholders
Act as the key interface between product, design, and delivery teams
Ensure alignment across all parties to achieve project objectives
Support effective communication and coordination throughout the project lifecycle

Risk & Quality Management

Identify, manage, and mitigate project and delivery risks
Ensure projects meet requirements for health & safety (CDM), programme, cost, constructability, delivery, and whole-life quality performance
Drive a culture of accountability, safety, and continuous improvement

WHAT WE'ER LOOKING FOR

Skills and experience matter, but character and attitude are just as important. We value proactive, positive people who genuinely care, take initiative, and go beyond expectations through their actions, not just their words.

Essential Experience

Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline (or equivalent experience)
Significant experience delivering complex infrastructure or engineering projects, particularly:
Multidisciplinary project coordination
Capital project delivery across design and construction phases
Delivery of modular or standardised solutions (desirable but not essential)

Strong working knowledge of:
Project delivery methodologies (e.g. waterfall, stage-gate, or agile where applicable)
Commercial and cost management principles
Programme planning and scheduling tools

Experience managing consultants, contractors, and external stakeholders
Proven ability to drive projects forward, resolve issues, and deliver practical outcomes

Level

Ideally operating at Senior Project Manager level, but strong Project Managers / Advanced professionals will be considered

Key Attributes

Delivery-focused with strong problem-solving mindset
Innovative and open to new ways of working
Highly collaborative with strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills
Proactive, organised, and able to manage competing priorities

Desirable

Experience in water, wastewater, or infrastructure sectors
Exposure to standardised, modular, or product-based delivery approaches
Understanding of CDM regulations and project delivery responsibilities
Professional certification (e.g. APM, PRINCE2, PMP) or working towards
Experience driving cost optimisation, efficiencies, or value-led delivery

Skills and experience are important, but character, positivity, and a caring attitude matter too. We seek people who get involved, want to be part of something bigger, and make a difference because they care.

How We’ll Reward And Care For You

Working here isn’t just a job. You can build a career at Severn Trent. We’ll reward you for it, too. We have a range of benefits that recognise great work, and award-winning training to help you reach your potential. And we’ll also help you play your part in looking after the environment and the communities where we live.

With That In Mind, Here Are Just Some Of Our Favourite's Perks That You’ll Get Being Part Of The Severn Trent Family

28 days holiday + bank holidays (and the ability to buy/ sell up to 5 days per year)
Annual bonus scheme (of up to £2,250 of base salary per annum based on company performance)
Leading pension scheme – we will double your contribution (up to 15% when you contribute 7.5%)
Sharesave – the chance to buy Severn Trent Plc shares at a discounted rate
Dedicated training and development with our ‘Academy’
Electric vehicle scheme and retail offers
Family friendly policies
Two volunteering days per year

LET’S GO

We can't wait to hear from you! Have an updated CV ready and spare five minutes to apply. We'll let you know the outcome after the closing date, so keep an eye on your phone and emails.

Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

The following position is to join our RTX Corporate, Enterprise Services Data organization:

As a Senior Technical Project Manager, Data & AI Delivery
, you will drive the development and deployment of enterprise data and AI products across RTX corporate functions. Reporting to the Associate Director of Data and AI, you will collaborate with Enterprise Services Data teams, RTX corporate functions, and Business Unit (BU) stakeholders to shape data and AI priorities, lead strategic initiatives, and drive engagement and adoption of Enterprise Services Data products. Leveraging technologies such as ontology, data products, semantic layers, and AI, you will help advance the Corporate Data Office's strategy and deliver scalable solutions that improve business performance and decision-making. Success in this role requires an AI-first mindset, strong technical and project management capabilities, and the ability to influence and coordinate cross-functional teams to drive execution and measurable business outcomes.

What You Will Do

Lead complex, enterprise-scale data and AI initiatives from planning through development, deployment, and delivery across RTX corporate functions.
Partner with Enterprise Services and Business Unit teams to define data and AI priorities, align strategic objectives, and drive engagement and adoption of enterprise data products.
Collaborate with product owners, engineering teams, and business stakeholders to establish priorities, manage deliverables, and achieve Corporate Data Office objectives.
Lead Agile scrum teams, applying Agile methodologies and best practices to drive execution, accountability, and continuous delivery.
Provide hands-on technical expertise in designing, developing, and optimizing SQL stored procedures, views, and queries, including performance tuning across Databricks and Snowflake environments.
Support enterprise data integration initiatives using HVR (High Volume Replication) to replicate SAP data sources into Snowflake and Databricks.
Drive the development of ontology and semantic layers to establish trusted, consistent data foundations for enterprise AI solutions.
Partner with product owners and managers to shape and provide input into the XETA AI product roadmap, helping accelerate product adoption and time to value.
Develop comprehensive reporting, statistical models, and business performance forecasts by leveraging enterprise data and AI platforms.
Identify and remove project impediments, proactively escalating risks and blockers to senior leadership to maintain progress and delivery commitments.
Ensure projects and products follow established Agile and Scrum methodologies, software development practices, and delivery standards.
Maintain project documentation, milestones, and status updates in Confluence, providing consistent weekly reporting to stakeholders and leadership.
Identify opportunities to transition manual processes to scalable digital and AI-enabled solutions through incremental, multi-generational roadmaps.
Monitor data integrity, quality, pipeline performance, and system reliability, identifying and resolving issues that impact successful delivery.

Qualifications You Must Have

Typically requires a Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience and a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience, or an Advanced Degree in a related field and a minimum of 7 years of relevant experience.
Experience managing complex, large-scale data and AI initiatives across multiple teams and stakeholders.
Experience working in a data-driven organization where enterprise data is leveraged as a strategic business asset.
Experience with large-scale application architecture, enterprise systems, and integration patterns.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or AWS, Kubernetes, and AI technologies.
Experience leading teams through digital transformation initiatives using Agile development methodologies and Scrum practices.

Qualifications We Prefer

Hands-on experience designing, developing, and optimizing SQL stored procedures, views, and queries, including performance tuning in Databricks and Snowflake.
Experience with HVR (High Volume Replication) for replicating SAP data sources into Snowflake and Databricks.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including diagnosing data integrity and quality issues, pipeline failures, and performance bottlenecks.
Strong understanding of the software development and engineering lifecycle, from solution conception through development, integration, and delivery.
Experience developing ontology and semantic layers to support trusted enterprise data and AI solutions.
Experience with the XETA AI suite of tools to improve productivity, accelerate delivery, and increase time to value.
Experience shaping product roadmaps and partnering with product owners and engineering teams to deliver enterprise data and AI products.
Experience developing incremental, multi-generational technology roadmaps that transition manual processes into digital and AI-enabled solutions.
Demonstrated ability to drive enterprise transformation, influence without direct authority, and coordinate delivery across complex organizational structures.
Strong technical and business acumen, with the ability to translate business objectives into actionable data and AI initiatives.
Ability to prioritize competing demands, assess business value, and focus resources on the highest-impact initiatives.
Strong communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and resolve conflicts across cross-functional teams.
Ability to work independently, adapt to changing priorities, and maintain focus in a complex, rapidly evolving (VUCA) environment.

In Person: Boston, MA Headquarters

Step into a pivotal Security Leadership
role at a fast-growing grid intelligence company.

LineVision’s customers include eight of the ten largest US utilities, which demand the highest levels of security in order to protect sensitive data and the electric grid from attack. You will lead LineVision to advance Product and Enterprise security to give customers confidence to rely on LineVision.

Reporting to the VP of Security, IT, and Quality, you will have broad autonomy over security engineering, security operations, controls execution, governance, and compliance. You and a Security Analyst will guide the security of our Products (AWS Platform, RS-1 optical and weather sensors) and Enterprise (SaaS platforms, IAM, endpoints, etc) across the full spectrum of security and compliance responsibilities, including annual SOC 2 Type II audits and ISO 27001 certifications, risk management, vulnerability management, incident response, penetration testing program, and customer security questionnaires. Partnering with IT, Platform, Hardware, and Customer Success, you will combine your vision and hands-on experience to build security into a strategic business advantage at LineVision.

If you want to build a security program that is seen as a strategic differentiator and wins customer trust, join us at LineVision, Built In Boston Best Places to Work
!

Please note: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship.

What will you do?

Core Responsibilities And Key Performance Objectives

Compliance Program Ownership: Own the annual audit cycle for SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 using the Vanta compliance platform, including all controls, internal audits, external audits, and nonconformity tracking to closure.
Risk Management & Governance: Lead the annual NIST CSF risk assessment, monthly Platform and Hardware risk reviews, and quarterly Governance, Risk & Compliance reviews. Maintain policies and report ISMS efficacy metrics to leadership.
Security Engineering: Conduct AWS cloud and Sensor penetration tests, ISA/IEC 62443 product security assessments, vendor and product risk assessments.
Security Operations: Oversee vulnerability management, CrowdStrike Falcon Complete detection rules, NextGen SIEM data feeds, and the MSSP relationship. Monitor open-source license compliance with FOSSA.

Description

Job Summary:

The Program Manager provides comprehensive leadership and oversight of multiple government-contract projects and operational efforts, from requirements development and proposal support through execution, delivery, and closeout. This position is accountable for program performance, financial planning and execution, resource allocation, contract compliance, risk management, and the supervision of assigned personnel. The Program Manager serves as a primary interface among government customers, company leadership, technical and operational teams, contracting and finance personnel, subcontractors, and vendors to meet mission requirements while maintaining cost, schedule, quality, and contractual performance.

Job Functions

Lead and coordinate multiple concurrent projects and tasking efforts; translate customer requirements and statements of work into actionable plans, schedules, deliverables, staffing requirements, and execution priorities.
Develop and maintain project baselines, milestone schedules, work breakdowns, resource plans, action-item trackers, and other program management tools; identify dependencies and adjust plans as mission needs evolve.
Coordinate operational and technical teams to plan, resource, and execute field activities, flight and test events, demonstrations, training, and other customer-directed requirements.

Forecast staffing needs; coordinate recruiting, onboarding, qualifications, training, travel, and workforce assignments to support customer requirements and operational readiness.
Coordinate with technical and operations leadership to support safety, qualifications, procedural compliance, equipment availability, and effective execution of field activities.
Maintain productive working relationships with government sponsors, technical managers, subcontractors, vendors, and internal departments; ensure issues are communicated and resolved promptly.
Support business development, capture, proposal preparation, pricing inputs, and identification of follow-on requirements and new work opportunities.
Prepare and maintain program records, lessons learned, risk registers, standard operating processes, and transition or closeout documentation.
Coordinate with leadership on process improvements, workload balancing, performance metrics, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Perform other related duties within the scope of the position as assigned.

Experience supporting Special Operations Command (SOCOM) a plus but not required.

Description

Job Title: Strategic Operations Manager, AI

Reports To: Head of Learning.ai (UGHE, CTLT)

Location: University of Global Health Equity (UGHE), Rwanda

Purpose of the Job

Reporting to the Head of Learning.ai (UGHE, CTLT), the Strategic Operations Manager owns the measurement framework and reporting for the Learning.ai portfolio, including the OneSpaceAfrica (OSA) platform and the eLearning program. The role (i) defines and tracks the metrics that show whether OSA is working, including the quality, reliability, safety, and fairness of its AI-enabled features, (ii) builds the outcomes and evaluation framework used to report results to partners, including COMS-A, and to donors, and (iii) works with the team to turn OSA performance data into findings for academic publication. The role also contributes to the design of needs assessments across the COMS-A network.

Key Responsibilities

Own the Learning.ai measurement framework, defining the core metrics used to evaluate OSA and the broader portfolio, including engagement, efficacy, efficiency, and AI performance, and setting the targets the team is held to. This includes the outcomes used to assess AI quality, reliability, safety, bias and fairness, and human review effectiveness ;
Track progress against targets with the Head of Learning.ai and the Manager, Product & Engineering, holding the roadmap accountable to evidence without owning the roadmap itself ;
Define what AI and product outcomes need to be measured, and works with engineering so the platform captures the data evaluation requires. Product decisions, instrumentation, and the roadmap stay with the Product and Engineering team ;
Lead evaluation design for each funding phase, including primary and secondary outcomes, a baseline and comparator approach drawing on pilot usage and infrastructure data, implementation fidelity measures, adoption and usage thresholds, AI performance and safety measures, and the success thresholds that would justify further investment. C ontribute faculty time and cost metrics, including cost per site and cost per student, to funding proposals ;
Contribute to needs -assessment design , working with the Partner Success Coordinator on interview and survey instruments so that findings can feed the evaluation framework ;
Hire and manage the Phase 0 needs-assessment consultant(s) and the Senior Advisor, Metrics, Analytics, and AI Evaluation, and hold them to their terms of reference. Day-to-day direction of needs-assessment fieldwork sits with the Partner Success Coordinator ;
Design the data strategy for performance management , determining what the OSA platform captures directly and what comes from surveys, interviews, and other faculty and student input, first at UGHE and then across the COMS-A network ;
Co-own the data management plan with the Infrastructure and DevOps Engineer, covering de-identification, data deposit, and the ethics approval required before platform data is used for research ;
Lead reporting to partners, donors, and internal leadership , and set the guardrails for how OSA results are reported externally ;
Prepare OSA performance findings for academic publication , working with the team on analysis and write-up ;
Work with external advisors , CTLT, COMS-A, and PIH's monitoring and evaluation team to ground Learning.ai's measurement approach in established practice.

Key Deliverables

Approved Learning.ai measurement framework, with defined metrics, targets, and AI quality, reliability, safety, and fairness measures
Evaluation design for each funding phase, including baseline, comparator, and success thresholds
Data strategy and data management plan in place, with ethics approval secured before platform data is used for research
Timely and accurate reporting to partners, donors, and internal leadership
OSA performance findings prepared for academic publication

Qualifications, Knowledge, And Skills

Academic qualifications
Bachelor’s degree required in a quantitative or research-oriented field (e.g., Statistics, Economics, Public Health, Social Science, Data Science, or Business); master’s degree preferred
Experience
Experience designing or managing program evaluation, M&E, or impact measurement; experience in education, global health, or international development preferred
Experience measuring or evaluating digital or AI-enabled systems, including the ability to work with technical and domain experts to define meaningful measures of quality, reliability, safety, and fairness
Experience with research design and ethics review, including baselines, comparators, and governance of personal data
Project management experience, including scoping work and managing external consultants
Technical competencies
Strong quantitative skills, with experience defining metrics, building reporting, and turning data into recommendations for decision-makers
Comfortable working with product and engineering teams to define what data needs to be captured and how
Excellent oral and written communication skills in English; English proficiency required
French and/or Kinyarwanda proficiency preferred
Behavioral competencies
Ability to work effectively in a team in a complex, fast-paced environment
Exceptional interpersonal skills, including the ability to interact professionally with culturally diverse staff, partners, and clients
Flexibility and agility
Passion for social justice and global health

How to Apply

Applicants should provide: (1) curriculum vitae, (2) degree, (3) a cover letter describing your interest in UGHE and relevant experience. Please upload these under the ‘Additional Files’ tab on the application page.

University of Global Health Equity is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Organizational Profile

UGHE is a new kind of university focused on training the next generation of global leaders in health care delivery. The university launched in Rwanda in September 2015. Through an academic experience uniquely rooted in the values of equity, students are empowered to both ease suffering at the bedside and drive transformational, systemic changes to the health system.

UGHE is an initiative of Partners In Health (PIH), an internationally recognized non-profit organization whose mission is to provide a preferential option for the poor in health care. new_jobs.title: Implementation Manager
new_jobs.description:
Accurx is where conversations happen with and about patients in the NHS

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that connects everyone through communication.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient, has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices and 68% (and growing!) of NHS Trusts.

Our platform now powers Total Triage
to manage patient demand, and Self-Book
that lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires
for long-term conditions, while Accumail
finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe
,
our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.

Gamechanging, right? Here's what you'll be getting stuck into to make it work

As an Implementation Manager,
you’ll be the one making sure our most ambitious tools actually land and stick in Secondary care. You won't just be ticking boxes on a rollout list; you’ll be leading the charge on high-impact transformations, like helping clinicians and admin teams move over to Accurx Scribe
.
You'll spend your time figuring out how these tools fit into the daily lives of clinicians, making sure they aren't just "installed," but are genuinely making things better for everyone.

Driving deep transformation: Leading big-scale rollouts for complex products like Scribe, making sure we’re not just doing the basics but fundamentally changing how healthcare is delivered.
Strategic boundary-setting: Standing firm on implementation plans and managing commercial expectations to ensure we deliver sustainable solutions without overcommitting.
Owning the AI journey: Becoming the go-to expert on our emerging AI features, taking full ownership of how they are introduced to practices and scaled across the country.
Closing the feedback loop: Reviewing practice cohorts 6-9 months after go-live to see if they’re actually using the product as intended and figuring out how we can make it even better.
Scaling with smarts: Using our internal AI dashboards to handle the "heavy lifting" of data, so you can focus on the human side of implementation while we automate the repetitive bits.
Raising the bar: Constantly looking for ways to improve our processes—if something isn't working or could be more efficient, you’ll have the autonomy to change it.

You should apply if...

You’ve been around the block with big rollouts: You have solid experience managing complex implementations in a fast-paced business and you know how to keep a project moving.
You’re a "driver," not a "passenger": You don't wait to be told what to do; you dive into the context, spot the problems, and take the lead on solving them.
You can hold your own: You’re comfortable having tough conversations with stakeholders and can stay firm on what’s achievable
You’re a natural communicator: You can explain technical or complex changes in a way that feels clear, simple, and actually exciting for the people using them.
You’re relentlessly resourceful: When you hit a roadblock, you don't just stop - you find a creative way over, under, or through it.
You care about the "why": You’re motivated by the idea of fixing healthcare communication and want to see the real-world impact of your work on clinicians and patients.

What’s in it for you?

You’ll join a high-performing team on a mission to solve healthcare productivity, building a platform used by around 300k NHS staff every week, supporting the care of over 50 million NHS patients every year. We set a high bar, move fast, and give people the ownership and support to do the best work of their careers

£45,000 - £60,000 salary, plus a discretionary recognition bonus for exceptional performance and impact, nominated by managers and awarded by our leadership team
Equity: £15,000 in equal share options, so you share in the value you help create
Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life
Built for collaboration: We are an office-first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office for a minimum of 3 days a week
Close to our users: Regular hackathons, plus dedicated time to visit GP practices and other healthcare settings to see first-hand how our products are used
Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year
Support at home: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support
We have our very own chefs: Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches, plus a weekly sweet treat

Job Description

The Opportunity

OCI is evolving the application and infrastructure deployment capabilities that help engineering teams deliver regular, reliable code updates to production. Our change-management and release-management tooling provides the workflows, controls, and operational visibility needed to move services forward while maintaining the highest standards of production stability.

As a Technical Program Manager, you will coordinate delivery of these core platform capabilities across engineering teams. You will bring structure to complex release dependencies, help teams translate operational needs into clear plans, and support the safe adoption of automation that improves deployment frequency, reduces manual effort, and protects production reliability.

What We Are Looking For

Required qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

3+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering operations, release engineering, product operations, or a related role in a technical environment.
Experience supporting application deployment, infrastructure automation, CI CD, release engineering, cloud infrastructure, or comparable platform programs.
Ability to work effectively with technical teams and understand deployment workflows, change-management controls, release dependencies, production risk, and operational tradeoffs.
Demonstrated ability to create clear plans, manage milestones and actions, communicate status, and bring stakeholders together to resolve delivery and operational issues.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with care for precise documentation, release readiness, and consistent follow-through.
A collaborative, customer-oriented, and data-informed approach to improving software delivery, change management, and production stability.

Preferred qualifications:
Experience in one or more of the following areas is a plus.

Application deployment platforms, continuous delivery, release management, change management, or deployment orchestration.
Infrastructure-as-code, GitOps, cloud infrastructure automation, configuration management, or infrastructure deployment.
CI CD, source control, build and test automation, artifact management, release engineering, or workflow orchestration.
Site reliability engineering, incident response, observability, production readiness, software supply-chain controls, or compliance automation.
OCI services or comparable large-scale public cloud environments.

Why This Role

You will help define how OCI engineering teams safely deliver change to production. The programs and tooling you support will enable more frequent code updates, reduce release friction, and help maintain the stability and operational confidence that critical cloud services require.

About OCI

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure delivers cloud services for organizations worldwide. The OCI Developer Platform team creates the capabilities that help engineering organizations build, deploy, and operate software with speed, confidence, and control.

Responsibilities

What You Will Do

Coordinate programs that deliver application and infrastructure deployment capabilities, automated change management, and release-management tooling used across OCI.
Work with engineering, product, SRE, security, compliance, and operations partners to define milestones, dependencies, readiness criteria, and success measures for production changes.
Support the design, delivery, and adoption of automated deployment and change workflows that provide appropriate approvals, policy controls, auditability, and rollback paths.
Drive initiatives that enable frequent, predictable production code refreshes while reducing manual release work, deployment friction, and operational risk.
Track execution across teams, identify release risks and blockers early, and coordinate timely decisions, escalation, and follow-through through rollout.
Use operational signals such as deployment success rates, change failure rates, lead time, rollback frequency, and incident data to assess program health and prioritize improvements.
Communicate release readiness, risks, dependencies, and recommended actions clearly to stakeholders across the engineering organization.

new_jobs.title: FinCrime Data Analyst Lead
new_jobs.description:
Join us as a FinCrime Data Analyst Lead at Barclays, where you will act as the Data Analytics Lead for Financial Crime Agile Testing. You will oversee data analytics work performed within the Agile Testing team and define the analytical testing approach for individual reviews. Working in partnership with Agile Testing colleagues, you will translate review triggers into executable objectives, hypotheses and data analytics testing plans, provide input to review scope, and determine data requirements and analytical design. You will quality-control analytical scripts and outputs, communicate data-led findings and observations to stakeholders, and act as the escalation route for Data Analytics Specialists and Analysts. Through independent judgement, technical assurance and constructive challenge, you will help deliver timely, risk-based and hypothesis-led testing of Financial Crime processes and controls.

Purpose of the Role

To oversee and lead the data analytics work supporting Financial Crime Agile Testing reviews. The role determines the overall data analytics approach, defines executable analytical objectives, hypotheses and testing plans for individual reviews, provides quality control over analytical scripts and outputs, and translates data into testable insight that supports assessment of the operational effectiveness of Financial Crime controls.

Key Accountabilities

Oversee data analytics work performed within the Financial Crime Agile Testing team, including defining the data analytics testing strategy required for individual reviews.
Translate review triggers into executable objectives, hypotheses and data analytics testing plans, providing data-led input to scoping decisions in collaboration with non-Data Analytics review colleagues.
Provide leadership and technical oversight for the development of analytical test objectives, methodologies and scripts using SQL, Python and SAS; review and approve analytical work to support robust and reproducible testing outcomes.
Identify and agree data needs and analytical design with the Agile Testing Lead during review planning and test-plan development.
Coordinate delivery of analytics with the Agile Testing Lead during testing execution, while Data Analytics Specialists and Analysts design scripts, source data and perform analysis.
Perform quality-control reviews of analytical scripts, including SQL, SAS and Python, designed by Data Analytics Specialists and/or Data Analytics Analysts, challenging logic, assumptions, data quality, caveats and the sufficiency of analytical evidence.
Review analytical outputs and workpaper content to support clear, accurate and reproducible documentation of the testing performed, evidence obtained and conclusions supported by the analysis.
Interpret and communicate findings and observations arising from data analytics testing to external stakeholders and provide analytical insight and draft input to review conclusions and reporting.
Act as the escalation route for Data Analytics Specialists and Analysts, addressing analytical judgement matters within authority and escalating material risk, scope, timeline or stakeholder issues where appropriate.
Work alongside the Agile Testing Lead as part of stage-gate oversight and peer cross-review, preserving independent challenge and clear accountability between Testing and Data Analytics roles.
Support the ongoing review and improvement of data analytics requirements within the Agile Testing methodology and contribute to efficient, risk-based and hypothesis-led review delivery.
Maintain independence and objectivity, ensure timely escalation, secure evidence retention, data-privacy compliance and high-quality documentation across data analytics work.

Stakeholder Management and Leadership

The role requires strong engagement across business teams and larger FinCrime Agile testing team. The VP determines the overall data analytics approach and analytical scoping decisions for individual reviews. The role exercises independent judgement when setting analytical hypotheses and approaches, reviews work completed by Data Analytics Specialists and Analysts, and acts as their escalation route. The role also contributes to the strategic development of the Financial Crime Agile Testing analytics capability and adoption of improved tools and techniques

Basic / Essential Qualifications

Strong experience leading data analytics work in Financial Crime, Compliance, Risk, Audit, Assurance or another control-testing environment.
Strong SQL and Python capability, including the ability to review and challenge analytical scripts, logic, assumptions and outputs developed by others.
Experience translating risk or review triggers into analytical objectives, hypotheses, testing plans, data requirements and executable analytical approaches.
Strong understanding of Financial Crime processes, risks and controls across relevant domains such as AML, Sanctions, Customer Due Diligence/KYC, Fraud or Transaction Monitoring.
Experience applying data analytics to assess control effectiveness using full-population or targeted testing approaches.
Strong technical assurance, critical-thinking and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify data-quality issues, anomalies, control weaknesses, caveats and limitations.
Experience reviewing analytical evidence and workpapers to determine whether testing outputs sufficiently support observations and conclusions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain analytical findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong stakeholder engagement, collaboration and constructive-challenge skills, with the ability to exercise independent judgement and escalate appropriately.
Ability to coordinate analytical delivery, provide technical guidance and act as an escalation point for Data Analytics Specialists and Analysts.

Desirable Skillsets

Experience contributing to Financial Crime assurance or Agile Testing methodology and improving analytical testing standards or ways of working.
Experience with SAS, data visualisation tools such as Tableau, statistical analysis, data mining or AI-enabled analytics.
Experience developing reusable analytical assets or automated testing approaches that improve testing efficiency, consistency or coverage.
Knowledge of advanced statistical or machine-learning techniques used to identify patterns, trends and relationships in data.
Working knowledge of AWS cloud services, LLM architectures, including responsible AI principles and appropriate solution validation.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in the role, including technical assurance, critical thinking, Financial Crime risk and control analysis, root-cause analysis, systems proficiency, stakeholder engagement, collaboration and data analytics using SQL and Python, as well as job-specific skillsets.

Role is based out of Pune.

Purpose of the role

To enable data-driven strategic and operational decision making through extracting actionable insights from large datasets, performing statistical and advanced analytics to uncover trends and patterns, and presenting findings through clear visualisations and reports.

Accountabilities

Investigation and analysis of data issues related to quality, lineage, controls, and authoritative source identification, documenting data sources, methodologies, and quality findings with recommendations for improvement
Designing and building data pipelines to automate data movement and processing.
Apply advanced analytical techniques to large datasets to uncover trends and correlations, develop validated logical data models, and translate insights into actionable business recommendations that drive operational and process improvements, leveraging machine learning/AI.
Through data-driven analysis, translate analytical findings into actionable business recommendations, identifying opportunities for operational and process improvements.
Design and create interactive dashboards and visual reports using applicable tools and automate reporting processes for regular and ad-hoc stakeholder needs.

Vice President Expectations

To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Apogee is seeking a Journeyman All-Source Intelligence Analyst
to support the Forces and Technologies Intelligence Group at the National Air and Space Intelligence Center (NASIC), Wright-Patterson AFB, Dayton, OH. The analyst supports scientific and technical intelligence analysis of foreign research and development in emerging and disruptive technologies within assigned areas of interest. Working under the direction of senior analysts, this role assists in assessing technology impacts on future weapon system concepts, characteristics and performance, and disruptions to the future battlespace.

Contingent Upon Contract Award****

Draft portions of reports, briefings, and other analytic products for senior review
Collaborate with senior analysts to refine analytic questions, methodologies, and products
Provide technical support in the appropriate phenomenology, mission processes, data sources, and analytic disciplines to support intelligence production efforts
Assist in synthesizing intelligence from multiple sources into coherent assessments related to emerging and disruptive technologies
Support the development of finished intelligence products across assigned domains including air and strike platforms, integrated air defense systems (IADS), C4ISR systems-of-systems, physics, chemistry, and biotechnology
